## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (82%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Severe blur (severity 3) flagged reliability [F6], models disagree, and frozen margins defer [F7]; order recut or deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 82%, InSitu 18%, Benign <1%, Normal <1% [F1] | Favors Invasive; InSitu second |
| Conformal set | Invasive (10% alpha; 90% test coverage, 5% ECE) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 44% reliability (flagged); 100% OOD; 10/12 regions kept | Suspect input; blur severity 3 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | False (top class disagrees) | Independent foundation models split |
| Similar cases | 2/5 (40%) Invasive; 3/5 InSitu [F5] | Weak neighbor support; InSitu common |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce score (-0.58; +0.95 contribution) pushes toward invasive [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Scarce score (-0.55; +0.59 contribution) pushes toward invasive; caption inconsistent [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Low-normal score (z=-0.46; +0.33 contribution) pushes toward invasive [F4] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-average score (z=-0.33; +0.21 contribution) favors invasive over InSitu · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Near-average score (z=-0.06; -0.15 contribution) slightly opposes invasive call · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability vs random (+0.011, 95% CI 0.002–0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.009–0.006 includes 0); relies on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20 AI spotcheck) and mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severe blur (severity 3, 100% OOD; 70% error AUROC) distorts tissue architecture; drafted recut and deeper levels may clarify.
- True lesion is InSitu (18% probability, 3/5 neighbors, contrast BACH_0242 at 73% similarity), given model disagreement and unconfirmed invasion.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 6, 5**: Highest classifier risk (0.46, 0.45, 0.25); check for invasion versus duct-confined InSitu in region 6.
2. **Regions 5, 10**: Highest stromal-infiltration scores (0.62, 0.63); verify whether stromal invasion exists despite blur.
3. **Regions 7, 8, 9**: Check if blur mimics absent lobules or tubules; defer frozen margins and review recuts.
